tidyhwsd: getting started

tidyhwsd authors

2026-02-04

Source: vignettes/tidyhwsd.Rmd
tidyhwsd.Rmd

Overview

tidyhwsd provides a tidyverse-friendly interface to the Harmonized World Soil Database (HWSD) v2.0. It returns tibbles for point queries and terra::SpatRaster objects for spatial queries.

For a detailed tutorial, see vignette("tutorial").

Download the HWSD grid

The HWSD index grid (HWSD2.bil) is not shipped with the package. Download it once to a writable directory:

# Replace with your preferred path
hwsd_download(ws_path = "~/data/HWSD2", verbose = TRUE)

You can set WS_PATH in ~/.Renviron to make the path persistent between sessions:

WS_PATH=~/data/HWSD2

Point queries (tibble output) 

pt <- hwsd_extract(
  coords = c(110, 40),
  param = c("SAND", "PH_WATER"),
  layer = "D1",
  ws_path = "~/data/HWSD2"
)

Share-weighted synthesis

Use hwsd_compose() to synthesize values across components:

props <- hwsd_props()
pt_syn <- hwsd_compose(
  coords = c(110, 40),
  param = c("SAND", "PH_WATER"),
  layer = "D1",
  ws_path = "~/data/HWSD2",
  props = props
)

Bounding box queries (SpatRaster) 

sand_cn <- hwsd_extract(
  bbox = c(70, 18, 140, 54),
  param = "SAND",
  layer = "D1",
  ws_path = "~/data/HWSD2",
  tiles_deg = 5,
  cores = 4
)
